p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); bg=max(set(sum(g,[])),key=sum(g,[]).count)
    if bg not in (0,8): return g
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    lines=[]
    for r,c in seeds:
      col=g[r][c]
      for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
       rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
       if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==col:
        lines.append((r,c,dr,dc,col))
    for r,c,dr,dc,col in lines:
      for sign in (-1,1):
       a,b=r,c
       while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W:
        if g[a][b]==bg: g[a][b]=col
        a+=sign*dr; b+=sign*dc
    return g
')
